description: Come out shelling on the remote barrier islands around Marco Island. Trust our captains to bring you to the best shelling beaches, such as Kice Island, Dickman's Point, Caxambas Sandbars, and Second Chance "Shell Island."

Parking
Cooler with Ice
Shelling Bags
Shelling Lessons
Professional Naturalist Shelling Guide
Expert Captain
highlights:
The Half-Day Super Shelling Tour with Florida Island Tours is designed for guests who want more time, more shoreline, and better chances at exceptional shell finds. This extended adventure travels deeper into the Ten Thousand Islands, reaching remote barrier islands and passes where tides naturally concentrate shells. With extra time on the water, the tour follows conditions rather than a fixed route, allowing captains to chase the best shelling opportunities of the day.

Throughout the experience, guests enjoy multiple island stops and longer time ashore to explore freshly exposed beaches. Captains share practical shelling tips, explain why certain tides produce better finds, and help guests identify favorites like sand dollars, lightning whelks, and other Gulf Coast treasures. Wildlife encounters often add to the excitement, with dolphins, birds, and other marine life appearing along the way.

Built for shelling enthusiasts, curious families, and anyone who enjoys unhurried exploration, the Half-Day Super Shelling Tour offers a deeper connection to Marco Island’s natural rhythms. By combining expert guidance, remote locations, and a relaxed pace, this tour delivers a true shelling experience that feels immersive, rewarding, and memorable. 🐚✨
